[[File:DarkerCheese.jpg|thumb|right|150px|The Darker offers some cheese.]]
'''Cheese''' was a [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]]. It could be produced from the [[Milk/Legends|milk]] of many creatures, such as the [[Grasser]]s of [[Haruun Kal/Legends|Haruun Kal]].

The surface of [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]] was described as smelling like moldy cheese.

The [[Darker]] offered [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] a piece of cheese with living things moving on it.
